issues: No integrity problems: no file or network access, no pasted coordinates, no use of evaluation labels. The diff only adds restarts from saved good solutions (_ELITE) to the simulated-annealing loop.
The candidate (-2.636) equals the incumbent mean (-2.6360). With one run each this shows no improvement, so rejecting is consistent with the numbers.

_ELITE stores p[1] from the pool. I could not check from the diff that p[1] holds the centers. If it does not, _score should return None and the restart will not happen; neither case makes the result invalid.
The stall counter increases on every evaluation that produces a valid packing, not only on failed ones, so 60 means 60 evaluations without a new best. This is loose but not a bug.
The loop stops on a wall-clock limit (215 s), so identical runs can differ slightly. This was already true of the incumbent.
A z-score cannot strictly be computed from one run per arm (no variance estimate), but the difference is 0, so z = 0.
